title: Avocado Cottage Cheese Toast
summary: When you need a quick, filling, and nutritious meal, this avocado cottage cheese toast checks all the boxes. It’s loaded with protein, healthy fats, and flavor — the perfect breakfast or lunch to fuel…
ingredients: 2 slices toasted sourdough bread (or other bread of choice)
steps: Place all the ingredients on a chopping board. Use a knife to chop and mash everything together until well combined but still slightly chunky.
Assemble the toast: Spread the mixture generously over your toasted bread.
Sprinkle with more everything bagel seasoning or black pepper to taste. Enjoy!
